name: BuildFlow Governed Agent Action Layer
problem: An AI/agent needs to prepare or route enterprise actions while policy, tenant, version, approval, value and idempotency constraints remain authoritative outside the model.
use_when: let an AI act on business systems safely
AI agent needs approval before it changes ERP data
prevent stale approvals in agent workflows
add idempotency and receipts to AI business actions
give an LLM bounded enterprise permissions
AI should prepare actions but not become the authority
inputs: Authenticated ProposedAction, exact subject version, AuthorizationGrant and required approvals.
outputs: Policy disposition, internal ApprovalRequest where allowed and ActionExecutionReceipt for bounded internal actions.
pricing: No approved machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.
confirmation: The model is never authority. Material actions require configured grants and human confirmation. External purchasing/payment/accounting writes are currently disabled.
invocation_status: SOURCE-VERIFIED: public routing and authenticated policy-check/internal-approval primitives are implemented and build-tested; external client canary remains pending. No external business-action executor.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
